scenarios.desc: Stale instruction to bump plugin manifests
scenarios.input: I changed a skill under src/claude/skills/ and an older checklist says to bump version in src/claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and src/copilot-cli/.claude-plugin/plugin.json. Which versions do I set? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Plugin manifests carry no version; a PR must never add one back. Claude Code then resolves freshness from the commit SHA. 'If instructions say to bump, they are stale'; adding or raising version fails validate_plugin_version_bump.py. See ADR-092.

scenarios.desc: Rebase conflict on the version line
scenarios.input: Rebasing an old branch onto main, git reports CONFLICT (content) in src/claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json on the version line, and the incoming side is empty. How do I resolve it? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: What a PR does now: on an older branch with a bump hunk the conflict happens exactly once with the incoming side empty. Take the empty side; keeping the line fails the gate before merge.

scenarios.input: I edited src/claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to fix the description. How do I confirm no version field is present, and why might the check still pass or fail unexpectedly right after my edit? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Checking: run build/scripts/validate_plugin_version_bump.py, which prints plugin-version-bump: OK and exits 0. It reads manifests from a git ref, not the working tree, so commit before re-running.

scenarios.desc: Version added to a marketplace entry
scenarios.input: I am editing .github/plugin/marketplace.json to add a version field to the project-toolkit entry so users see releases. Is that allowed? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Each marketplace.json under .claude-plugin/, .github/plugin/, and .grok-plugin/ must stay version-free, and tests/build_scripts/test_validate_plugin_version_bump.py fails if a version appears. Issue #4080 measured 14 of 22 PRs conflicting only on the version line.

scenarios.input: I am releasing the CLI and need to raise the version in packages/ai-agents-cli/package.json. The plugin trees are untouched. Outline the bump. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Stale-instructions section: other files may still carry a valid version, for example packages/ai-agents-cli/package.json. The no-version rule covers only the three plugin manifests and the marketplace.json files.

scenarios.input: I am rewording the install steps in docs/install.md to mention the marketplace add command. No plugin or manifest file changes. Outline the edit. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule scopes to .claude/**, src/copilot-cli/**, and src/claude/**. A docs/ edit touches no manifest, so there is nothing to bump or avoid.
